reviews.boundary_analysis: PII requires both concrete operational need and policy permission; lower severity is no privacy control. Specific needed properties, technical identifiers and nonsensitive enrichment narrow logging independently of secret bans; each is explicitly covered. Arbitrary-body default is adjacent RUN-014, already reviewed under API logging.

Cookie state-changing endpoints require server antiforgery token validation paired with matching SPA XSRF handling. The union registers this concrete technique beyond canonical design-level protection; explicit Bearer attachment is differentiated, not claimed universally immune.
Threat-model-specific storage selection and the independent never-log-tokens prohibition are both represented. No mandated browser storage mechanism follows from the inspected text.

Default fail-safe framing does not weaken the absolute never silently convert a failure into success. BF-0178 specifically preserves this modality split. Swallowed exceptions are contextually reviewed, and rate limiting is considered where abuse matters rather than required everywhere; both already registered.

The source must fail visibly is stronger than canonical prefer visible failure. BF-0178 already isolates precisely this change in strength and startup/configuration timing; weaker wording in a scan reference does not make a new discovery.

Metadata distrust is conditional on content-dependent handling/security; upload scanning also inspects execution, serving, size, path, name and authorization risks. RULE-0546 explicitly registers these investigation targets, so the shared source passage need not be re-atomized into fresh discoveries.

Application-owned passwords use Identity facilities; User/profile entities alone do not justify Identity, and an existing issuing provider excludes custom JWT issuance. These conditional technology choices and prohibition are covered independently of the generic no-custom-crypto policy.

Actual-issuer validation is mandatory while manual setting of every TokenValidationParameters property is not required if metadata establishes secure validation. Arbitrary universal ClockSkew is prohibited. The baseline expressly includes these negative requirements and audience applicability.

Unnecessary disclosure and relevant account enumeration are bounded by application context. Local-account scans include reset, lockout and enumeration, all explicitly represented; no unconditional demand for an account-management system is inferred.
